column1: # LUAU-1 (review 2026-11-21): a doc string the table generator carries into
# a module (the unit view) is spelled in Luau's own escape syntax.
# TestLuauStringLiteralsAreLuauSyntax generates every module for each unit,
# loads each one under the pinned interpreter, and holds the spelling.
# marker: text of the doc a module must carry (the case still reaches a
# the defect: a rune Go's %q writes as \uXXXX, which Luau rejects (U+00AD
# soft hyphen, U+200B zero width space; schema check refuses U+2028 and U+2029
# in a doc line, SPEC §4.1, so no unit carries those)
# the control: the same unit with a doc Go's %q and Luau spell alike
